items.markdown:
The Thailand Elite Visa—officially rebranded as the **Thailand Privilege Card**—`offers long-term multi-entry residency ranging from 5 to 20 years through a one-time membership fee` , featuring key options like the Bronze tier (650,000 THB for 5 years), Gold tier (900,000 THB for 5 years), and Platinum tier (1,500,000 THB for 10 years).[](https://rumavi.com/en/property-guides/thailand-elite-visa) [[1]](https://rumavi.com/en/property-guides/thailand-elite-visa)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H1_z6X4N6N8&t=33)

Membership Tiers and Costs

- **Bronze:** 650,000 THB for 5 years (promotional entry tier)
- **Gold:** 900,000 THB for 5 years (includes annual privilege points)
- **Platinum:** 1,500,000 THB for 10 years
- **Diamond:** 2,500,000 THB for 15 years
- **Reserve:** 5,000,000 THB for 20 years (by invitation only)[](https://thailandprivilegecard.thaiembassy.com/how-much-is-the-5-year-elite-visa-in-thailand/) [[1]](https://thailandprivilegecard.thaiembassy.com/how-much-is-the-5-year-elite-visa-in-thailand/)

Key Program Benefits

- **No Annual Paperwork:** Skip standard yearly extensions and re-entry permits
- **VIP Services:** Fast-track airport immigration lanes and elite personal assistant assistance
- **Streamlined Approval:** Background check and approval process takes roughly 3 to 6 weeks without complex financial proof[](https://thailandprivilegecard.thaiembassy.com/how-much-is-the-5-year-elite-visa-in-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.thailandeelite.com/en/)[[2]](https://www.thaielite.com/news/thai-elite-visa-cost-comprehensive-guide-2025)

Important Limitations

- **No Work Rights:** Does not grant a local work permit for regular employment
- **Tax and Reporting Obligations:** Standard 90-day address reporting remains mandatory; staying over 180 days can trigger local tax residency rules[](https://rumavi.com/en/property-guides/thailand-elite-visa) [[1]](https://www.goldenvisas.com/thailand)

If you'd like to proceed, please let me know:

- How many **years of residency** you are looking for
- Whether you plan to apply **individually or with family** 

I can help you select the right membership tier.
